measured_basis: The original full CPU run measured an 813330432-byte peak delta, but the exact stage replay measured only 526364672 bytes, consistent with the prior same-core 516718592-byte result. Domain stages were not the maximum. Preserve both results and resolve the nonreproducibility with three prospective fresh processes.
unchanged_controls: Exact core and three package bytes unchanged.
Exact 100 plus 20 English and domain schedules unchanged.
Continuous 10 ms process-RSS peak monitor unchanged.
RSS, throughput, TTFT, active-memory, quality, and sparse-execution thresholds unchanged.
No training, teacher inference, data access, artifact mutation, garbage-collection injection, or runtime optimization.
decision_rule: Run exactly r1, r2, and r3 in separate CPU processes. The confirmation passes only if every replication passes every unchanged V1040 gate, including peak RSS below 602959872 bytes. Any replication failure closes measurement repetition and requires an actual activation-lifecycle or runtime-memory change before another product screen.
claim_boundary: Prospective replication of an unstable RSS measurement only. Even three passes require independent integrated evidence verification before a bounded Phase 7 machine certificate.
